peg_reference.notes: HUSD was marketed as a U.S. dollar-backed stablecoin before losing its peg and exchange support in 2022.

valuation_source.label: Historical issuer claims, exchange notices, and market pricing

yield_or_rebase_profile.notes: HUSD was not a rebasing asset.

peg_reference.notes: IRON targeted one U.S. dollar through a partially collateralized design using USDC and the TITAN share token.

valuation_source.label: IRON redemption design, collateral state, and market price during the June 2021 run

yield_or_rebase_profile.notes: IRON did not rebase; stability depended on collateral and TITAN mint/burn economics.

classification_notes: Terminal partially collateralized stablecoin collapse. Later Iron Finance activity is not treated as recovery of the original IRON.

peg_reference.notes: mUSD targeted one U.S. dollar through a basket of approved USD stablecoins and protocol mint/redemption mechanics.

valuation_source.label: mUSD basket accounting and legacy contract state

yield_or_rebase_profile.notes: mUSD itself did not accrue yield. imUSD and later yield products are separate assets.
